calvin_d_d.task_order_note: CALVIN tasks have no --task-id ordering: eval is over 5-subtask chains, not per task. This list stays as bare names and must not be read positionally.

libero_10.aka: LIBERO-Long (paper name). libero_10 is LIBERO's own id; the 10 is the task count, not a version -- LIBERO-100 splits into LIBERO-90 + LIBERO-10.

schema_v2_note: v1 listed `tasks` as bare names in alphabetical order. LIBERO's --task-id order is NOT alphabetical in any of the four suites, so reading that list positionally as a task_id was wrong (e.g. libero_goal put_the_bowl_on_the_stove is task 1, alphabetical index 4). v2 lists {task_id, name} objects in benchmark order.

record_schema.status: defined 2026-08-14; supersedes the 'undecided' note in README v1

run_id.no_timestamp: not required; uniqueness is the only hard constraint
run_id.never_encode: design sizes or completeness. A directory in the capture repo named preaction64x8 holds 28 of the 512 episodes it claims. All counts live in meta.json/sampling and are recomputed from data.

contents.meta.json: task_id, task_name, prompt, suite, wrist_layout, mig_uuid, mig_profile, max_steps, status, run_id, sampling{...}
contents.logs/: server.log + client.log for this task's run
contents.server/routes.zarr: Zarr v3 + Zstd(3). hb_expert_ids[N,8,10,11,4] uint8, hb_selected_prob f16, hb_entropy f16, hb_router_probs[N,8,10,11,32] f16 (full 32-way softmax, ~84% of all bytes), as_expert_ids[N,4], as_probs[N,4,3], episode_id[N] int32, control_step[N] int32. N = control steps, flat.
contents.client/summaries.json: per-episode success / action_steps / inference_calls / init_state_id / flow_noise_seed
contents.client/server_metadata.json: checkpoint sha256, wrist layout, flow steps
contents.client/episode_NNNN.npz: state, actions, sim_state per control step

sampling.purpose: make the sampling design machine-readable, so '64' never has to be inferred from a directory name
sampling.fields: design, designed_episodes, actual_episodes, coverage, complete, unique_init_states, unique_flow_noise_seeds, held_fixed[], varies[]
sampling.rule: actual_* are counted from client/summaries.json by corpus_layout.sampling_block(); consumers gate on complete

invariants: episode_id is authoritative for slicing the flat zarr
control_step is globally contiguous; a break means a dropped chunk
task directory names come from benchmark.get_task(i).name, never from ls

unsupported.calvin_d_d: no capture path in this toolchain at all

capture.note: every LIBERO task has exactly 50 initial states; more episodes than that requires repeated draws per scene and must be stated in sampling.design
capture.max_steps_source: HiMoE-VLA/examples/libero/main.py:60-69; the bridge's SUITE_MAX_STEPS carries only the first three
